Method
PASS 1

Validate

Resolve the entity, source type, jurisdiction and date before relying on a record.

PASS 2

Attack

Search for entity mix-ups, stale records, contrary evidence and repeated sources masquerading as independent confirmation.

PASS 3

Confirm

Recheck the decisive source and downgrade any claim that cannot survive the evidence.
